reads: Ten of ten questions attached the game's own notes and named the right wiki in the block's header, with no honesty line on any of them. The alias 'mario party' did not swallow the numbered games: each Mario Party question resolved to its own game.

The two-row header is on screen: the note's name and the count on the first row, the source alone on the second, the count never cut. Seen on every one of the ten and on the earlier Gonarch turn the other session had left.

One of ten game questions (Smash) showed the block only after completion, not live; the tip row earlier did the same. So the live path works most of the time (nine of ten here, with a full timeline on the tenth) and misses sometimes; the lane's timing guess fits a miss that happens near the end, but the Smash reply streamed for tens of seconds with no block, which does not. Left for the lane with the two examples.
The GTA III question resolved through the alias 'gta 3' to the Steam game with no game running, as the title ladder allows.
verdictSentence: Every one of the ten new games answers from its own notes on the Deck, with the block naming the note and the wiki; one block arrived late instead of live.
